decision: Keep the current 5-factor board as the runnable baseline, then expand the scoring design into hard gates, weighted factors, and risk/value modifiers before changing source code.

officialProspectMembership.rule: A player can enter the first-round candidate pool only if matched to the official Prospects list or explicitly approved by the supervisor.

officialDraftOrder.rule: Pick order and acquired-from notes follow NBA.com official order before all media mocks.

ignoredSources.rule: Social posts, community reposts, self-media videos, and encyclopedia pages are discovery-only and receive zero model weight unless manually promoted with primary evidence.

pickValueGuardrails: Top 5 picks should not reach more than one tier beyond consensus without a supervisor note.
Lottery reaches of 3 or more consensus slots require team-fit evidence and health check.
Late first can prioritize role/archetype fit, but not if source quality and health both fail.
A value fall can override a mild need mismatch when the player stays in the same risk tier.
officialCombineUse: Use official current-year measurements as hard facts once normalized.
Use historical Combine only for percentile calibration.
Do not penalize players for missing Combine rows unless absence itself is a sourced risk signal.

implementationOrder: Add optional healthAvailability, sourceConfidence, needConfidence, valueTier, and combineProfile fields to Prospect/TeamProfile without breaking imports.
Normalize current-year official Combine rows if available; keep historical rows as calibration only.
Implement health and source quality as modifiers before changing the UI default weights.
Add expanded 10-factor debug output in DraftPick.breakdown while preserving the current 5-slider UI.
Run board simulations for baseline, consensus-heavy, health-risk-averse, value-protection, and late-intel scenarios.
Supervisor reviews only the divergent picks and medical flags, then locks the final submission board.
